name: Political rights & civil liberties
question: How do published rights assessments describe India?

metrics.title: Freedom House overall score (2025)
metrics.explain: Freedom House classifies India as Partly Free in its 2025 edition. This is an expert-assessed index, not an objectively measured government performance percentage; editions are labelled, not assumed identical to calendar years.

name: Press & expression
question: What is documented about speech and press freedom?
description: Court orders, journalist incidents and independent assessments
note: Specific events require independently checked chronology, policing records and response from implicated authorities. An overall numeric verdict is withheld.

name: Protest & assembly
question: How have restrictions on assembly been applied?
note: A reliable nationwide incident register and official response review have not yet been compiled.

name: Institutional independence
question: How are oversight institutions functioning?
note: Institution-level records need separate criteria; a single mixed score would be misleading.

name: Political finance & transparency
question: How transparent is political funding?
description: Electoral bonds and related court decisions
note: The Supreme Court struck down the electoral bonds scheme in February 2024. This is a legal finding about that scheme, not a full index of political financing.

name: Internet restrictions
question: How often has internet access been deliberately interrupted?

metrics.title: Recorded internet shutdowns in India
metrics.explain: Access Now recorded 116 in 2023 and 84 in 2024. Incident counts are not equivalent to total affected people, geographical area or duration; state and Union authority must be differentiated.
